props.caption: Treasury announced Friday a temporary waiver to allow Russian diesel. Trump said Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 tonnes.
IRGC navy says a crude supertanker is burning in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a mine.

props.title: Gorkha, Budhi Gandaki
props.caption: Nepal's disaster authority said five people remain missing and 47 were rescued after a landslide-linked flood on the Budhi Gandaki in Gorkha. Mishra said five to seven houses at Jagat were swept away.

items.note: Treasury waived energy sanctions to allow Russian diesel. The first 300,000 tonnes have no named tanker.
IRGC says a crude tanker hit a mine and is burning. Who laid it, and whether she floats, is unknown.
NDRRMA says five remain missing after the Gorkha flood. House-loss figures still differ across reports.
The court ordered metro, rail and internet restored. Unwinding Saturday's 7,000 detentions is unpublished.

lead.what: Ledger left five calls open: the Reserve Bank of India oil-company dollar window through 13 October; Québec's 64-seat table by 12 October; Brazil's 25 October runoff; the December RBI repo hold; and the 22 October IEA leftover-stock withdrawal. Nothing settled.

Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then. The prior is 0.28.

rest.what: Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 13 October 2026, that Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation and Bharat Petroleum Corporation met their 12 October dollar requirements through the Reserve Bank of India's special window and did not bid for those dollars in the onshore spot market; no if any of the three is reported bidding in that market for those requirements, or if no such report is posted by that deadline. The prior is 0.64.

There is a 42% probability that a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 16 October 2026, that the first announced diesel step has been loaded onto tankers under the US Treasury energy-sector waiver announced on 9 October 2026.

lead.what: Iran's IRGC navy said Saturday a crude supertanker hit mines exiting Hormuz and caught fire. CENTCOM disabled Panama-flagged Ocean Molica in the Gulf of Oman on 10 October.

rest.what: Nepal's disaster authority said five people remain missing and 47 were rescued after a landslide-linked flood on the Budhi Gandaki in Gorkha. Mishra said five to seven houses at Jagat were swept away.

Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, sitting on Sunday, ordered no detention except by legal procedure and told Delhi to restore metro, rail and internet. About 41,000 security personnel detained 7,000 people on Saturday.
